messages:
Mia (People Ops): heads-up — we just got a huge spike in peer nominations after the product launch, ~420 entries in the last 3 hours. Need a triage plan.
Jordan (Rewards): wow ok. do we know duplicates or multiple noms for same person?
Mia (People Ops): Recognition Bot did a quick dedupe run, ~380 unique nominees, ~40 duplicates mostly from cross-posts.
Anika (Payroll): FYI if we fast-track >100 spot awards this month, need heads-up for tax reporting cutoff. Payroll batch closes Friday 11:59pm PT.
Sam (Legal): Also double-check recipients in APAC — some gift types trigger local tax withholding. We should limit instant gift cards to e-gift only for now.
Priya (Eng Mgr): From teams side we want to prioritize launch contributors first. Can we tag by "reason" field — launch-related nominations?
Mia (People Ops): Yes, nominations include a free-text reason. Recognition Bot put tag "launch" on ones that mention the release artifact. I can export CSV.
Jordan (Rewards): Proposed triage steps: 1) auto-approve up to 3 nominations per nominee 2) prioritize "launch" tag 3) route ambiguous ones to a small review panel.
Toby (Vendor Ops): For physical items (pins/plaques) vendors have 7-10 day lead times. If we decide physical > digital we need PO + shipping list by EOD tomorrow.
Mia (People Ops): Panel volunteers? Need 3 reviewers from ops/product/eng to sign off ambiguous cases. Prefer small to move fast.
Priya (Eng Mgr): I can do one, happy to help review 30-40.
Jordan (Rewards): I can do review and manage gift distribution. We'll default to $25 e-gift if approved.
Anika (Payroll): For any monetary award >$599 we have to record differently. $25 e-gifts are safe. Also confirm employee country codes in export.
Sam (Legal): Approve the $25 e-gift default. For exceptions (higher amount) require manager signoff + legal review.
Mia (People Ops): OK action items:
- Mia: export nominations CSV and add country + manager columns by 1pm (today)
- Recognition Bot: run rule to tag "launch" mentions (in flight)
- Priya/Jordan/Mia: review panel handling ambiguous ones — meet at 3pm
- Jordan: prepare e-gift distribution flow and queue for payroll cut Friday
- Toby: standby for physical item PO if panel requests (deadline EOD tomorrow)

Recognition Bot: Automated summary: 420 total submissions, 380 unique nominees, 120 tagged 'launch'.
Priya (Eng Mgr): 3pm works. Quick ask: can we batch-approve managers' direct reports to reduce load?
Mia (People Ops): Yes, add rule: auto-approve nominations where nominator is direct manager, unless flagged by panel.
Jordan (Rewards): I'll draft the comms to winners and managers after panel clears — short turnaround.
Anika (Payroll): Please flag any non-US recipients ASAP, I'll coordinate tax forms.
Sam (Legal): If panel elevates any high-value awards, we pause distribution until legal clears.
Mia (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll post the CSV in #people-ops-private and ping reviewers.
Toby (Vendor Ops): Noted — vendor backlog might push physical deliveries into next week, will confirm by noon tomorrow.
Jordan (Rewards): Nice work team. :tada: trying to keep this lightweight so people actually get recognized same week.
Mia (People Ops): Update after 3pm review.
Recognition Bot: [automated message] Panel meeting scheduled at 2024-06-18T15:00:00Z. 120 items queued for panel review.
